turns.question: By what percentage did our ad spend grow in the week of 14 September 2026 over the week before?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ad-spend week-over-week growth metric (the closest are bookings_wow_growth, leads_wow_growth and revenue_eur_wow_growth), so I will not compute a percentage myself; what it does give is Ad spend (EUR) of 1,415.00 EUR for the week starting 7 September 2026 (7-13 Sep) and 1,500.00 EUR for the week of 14 September 2026 (14-20 Sep). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
